principles: Create an original image. Do not reproduce existing artworks, branded characters, logos, copyrighted IP, celebrities, or identifiable public figures.
Do not imitate or reference any named living artist, studio, photographer, illustrator, film, game, anime, or franchise.
Prioritize coherent composition, believable materials, intentional light, desktop-icon readability, and a clear visual hierarchy.
No text, signatures, watermarks, frames, UI overlays, duplicate subjects, malformed anatomy, or obvious generation artifacts.

briefs.subject: a remote basalt coastline after a passing storm
briefs.composition: wide low-angle view with a strong diagonal shoreline and open sky on the upper right
briefs.light: late golden hour breaking through cool rain clouds
briefs.avoid: tourists, buildings, boats, tropical postcard colors

briefs.subject: an elevated night transit interchange in a dense future city
briefs.composition: long-lens compression with layered roads and one clear visual anchor
briefs.light: rain-softened signage and practical sodium lights
briefs.palette: deep ink, restrained magenta, warm amber
briefs.avoid: cyberpunk clichés, excessive neon, flying cars, logos

briefs.subject: a small scientific observatory orbiting an ice giant
briefs.composition: off-center station silhouette with the planet occupying two thirds of the frame
briefs.light: soft reflected planetary light and tiny practical lamps
briefs.avoid: battle scenes, spaceships in formation, recognizable franchise design

briefs.subject: a monolithic concrete cultural pavilion beside shallow water
briefs.composition: strict frontal geometry interrupted by one narrow human-scale passage
briefs.light: overcast diffuse daylight with subtle reflections
briefs.palette: warm concrete, silver water, moss green
briefs.avoid: famous buildings, luxury villa clichés, crowds, text

briefs.subject: translucent mineral sheets folding through a dark void
briefs.composition: large sweeping curves with one crisp focal intersection
briefs.light: internal subsurface glow with controlled edge highlights
briefs.avoid: random blobs, glossy plastic, busy rainbow gradients

briefs.subject: an ancient cedar forest moments before dawn
briefs.composition: vertical trunks creating rhythm, a narrow stream guiding inward
briefs.light: very low blue ambient light with faint mist separation
briefs.avoid: horror figures, glowing eyes, fantasy creatures, crushed blacks

briefs.subject: a small lakeside reading cabin after fresh snow
briefs.composition: cabin placed at the lower left with broad quiet snowfield and frozen lake
briefs.light: soft morning sun behind thin cloud
briefs.palette: warm window amber, snow white, pale blue
briefs.avoid: Christmas decorations, people, smoke overload, commercial stock-photo look

briefs.subject: a botanical research garden suspended above a sea of clouds
briefs.composition: layered terraces receding into atmosphere with a small central greenhouse
briefs.light: early morning rim light and soft volumetric haze
briefs.avoid: castles, dragons, characters, game concept-art clichés
